from_quote: Without the intervention of the State legislatures, the President of the United States cannot be elected at all
rationale: Says the President "cannot be elected at all" without the State legislatures, which "must in all cases have a great share in his appointment"; this clause has each State appoint electors "in such Manner as the Legislature thereof may direct."

from_quote: The Senate will be elected absolutely and exclusively by the State legislatures
rationale: Says the Senate "will be elected absolutely and exclusively by the State legislatures," the mode of choosing Senators set in this clause.

from_quote: the power of collecting internal as well as external taxes throughout the States
rationale: Names the Union's "power of collecting internal as well as external taxes throughout the States," the taxing power given in this clause.

from_quote: The regulation of commerce, it is true, is a new power
rationale: Names "the regulation of commerce" as a new power of the Union under the proposed Constitution, the commerce power given in this clause.
